note: Every point where the mod touches New Vegas. Each row generates one hook. Fill the editor IDs/form IDs from the player's installed game; null = still to look up.

rows.purpose: Place the Custom Night terminal in Doc Mitchell's house
rows.trigger: new game / first load in Goodsprings

rows.purpose: Set time to 20:00, spawn nothing until the terminal's Begin is chosen, then start the spawn loop
Spawn mascots out of the player's sight using difficulty_scale bands
At 06:00 game time, despawn all mascots and give the reward
On death, clear mascots and reset the night state
Caps and an item scaled by the sum of the chosen levels
